_GOVERNANCE: HUMAN-ONLY. Copy this to taste.json and edit it to your taste. The AI may PROPOSE edits (staged to CAPCOM for your approval) but MUST NEVER write taste.json. This is your Will; the machine only attunes to it.
_how_to_read: weight = how much this physics axis pulls the preference (standardised units; sign is direction). conviction = how firmly you hold it — higher resists comparisons and chat (~0.25 precision per comparison, so conviction 5 resists roughly 20 comparisons before it bends). scale = the axis's characteristic spread, used to put every axis on one comparable scale.
_axes_are: the physics facts a domain's measure() reports, over which taste is expressed. These four are the attunement minigame's; a different feature declares its own.
